description: Watercolour tropical jungle in morning mist, 5056x3392: big banana leaves and palm fronds in sage and eucalyptus green on the left and bottom, pale taupe tree silhouettes fading into a warm cream fog in the middle, a toucan and a green parrot on a branch and a spotted leopard cub sitting on a thick branch at the right. Palette: sage green, soft eucalyptus, warm cream, pale taupe, with warm tan and black accents only on the animals. Calm, airy, no gendered cues.
